# unifi_port_forward (Data Source)

Look up a UniFi port forwarding rule by exactly one of `id` (legacy `_id`) or `name` within a site, using the legacy local Network API. Names must identify a unique rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unifi_site" "main" {
  name = "Default"
}

data "unifi_port_forward" "game" {
  site_id = data.unifi_site.main.id
  name    = "Game UDP"
  # Alternatively, set id to the legacy rule _id and omit name.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `site_id` (String) Integration site UUID.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Legacy rule ID.
- `name` (String) Rule name.

### Read-Only

- `destination_port` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `forward_ip` (String)
- `forward_port` (String)
- `logging_enabled` (Boolean)
- `protocol` (String)
- `source` (String)
- `wan_interface` (String)
